title: subagent-log.jsonl records an empty last_assistant_message when a subagent ends via SubagentHandback
description: Found by the TASK-240 reviewer (MEDIUM-1, CU2+CU3 review). In session 20260708T154259Z-29a27eda every TASK-240 developer/reviewer entry in subagent-log.jsonl has an empty last_assistant_message. The real hand-offs exist only as the SubagentHandback tool_use input in the agent transcripts. The durable record TASK-219 promises, and that bin/audit-reviewer-verdict.js corroborates against, is therefore empty whenever an agent ends with SubagentHandback. Also seen: entries whose last_assistant_message is the human's own chat message (e.g. 'si, hazlo', agent_type null), which suggests some events are misattributed. Suspects: hooks/persist-subagent.mjs and src/subagent-log.js.
acceptance_criteria: When a subagent ends via SubagentHandback, its log entry carries the hand-off text (or explicitly marks where it is), never an empty string that reads as 'nothing returned'.
When a subagent ends with plain text, the entry still carries that text as it does today.
bin/audit-reviewer-verdict.js tells 'no record' apart from 'record present but empty'.
Entries that are not a subagent's result (e.g. the human's chat message) are either not logged or clearly labeled.
